issue.body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/encode/starlette/discussions/2416
Originally posted by **aryaniyaps** January 13, 2024 I have my custom errors which are subclasses of the `Exception` class itself Here's an example: ```py # app/core/errors.py class BaseError(Exception): """Base error class.""" def __init__(self, message: str) -> None: self.message = message super().__init__(self.message) class InvalidInputError(BaseError): """Indicate that the client has issued an invalid request.""" ``` and this is my corresponding error handler: ```py # app/core/error_handlers.py from fastapi import Request from .errors import InvalidInputError async def handle_invalid_input_error( _request: Request, exception: InvalidInputError, ) -> Response: """Handle InvalidInputError expections.""" return ORJSONResponse( content={ "message": exception.message, }, status_code=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST, ) ``` I am using FastAPI but I believe that the error arises from the `add_exception_handler` method defined in starlette. While initializing my app like this: ```py # app/__init__.py from fastapi import FastAPI from app.core.error_handlers import handle_invalid_input_error from app.core.errors import InvalidInputError def create_app() -> FastAPI: """Initialize an app instance.""" app = FastAPI(version="0.0.1") app.add_exception_handler( InvalidInputError, handler=handle_invalid_input_error, ) return app ``` this mypy error arises: ``` error: Argument "handler" to "add_exception_handler" of "Starlette" has incompatible type "Callable[[Request, InvalidInputError], Coroutine[Any, Any, Response]]"; expected "Callable[[Request, Exception], Response | Awaitable[Response]] | Callable[[WebSocket, Exception], Awaitable[None]]" [arg-type] handler=handle_invalid_input_error, ```
> [!IMPORTANT] > - We're using [Polar.sh](https://polar.sh/encode) so you can upvote and help fund this issue. > - We receive the funding once the issue is completed & confirmed by you. > - Thank you in advance for helping prioritize & fund our backlog.
issue.title: Typing error for app.add_exception_handler (Argument "handler" to "add_exception_handler" of "Starlette" has incompatible type)
